card.name: The piece "oph" inside long words
card.fires_on: The piece "oph" in the middle of a longer word, mostly after "myc" (mycophenolate) or "hem" (hemophagocytic). Also seen in species and eye terms like heterophoria.

modes.label: Mycophenolate
modes.description: "oph" after "myc" in the immunosuppressant name mycophenolate mofetil.

modes.label: Other medical terms
modes.description: "oph" after "hem" or "heter" in terms like hemophagocytic or heterophoria.

card.plain: It fires partway through long medical words, most often mycophenolate and hemophagocytic.
